scim.unavailable.title: Activation unavailable
scim.unavailable.description: Open a fresh activation link from your notification. This link may have expired or been superseded.
scim.email.title: Verify your primary email
scim.email.description: Enter your email to request an independent verification. Directory email alone does not establish your identity.
scim.email.label: Email
scim.checkEmail.title: Check your email
scim.checkEmail.description: Open the verification link in your email to continue this activation.
scim.verified.title: Email verified
scim.verified.description: Continue to submit this activation for provisioning.
scim.pending.title: Provisioning pending
scim.pending.description: Your activation was submitted. Identity provisioning and team invitation progress are separate.
scim.pending.access: Access is not granted by this page. Follow the invitation notification when it becomes available; team acceptance is a separate step.
scim.error.temporary: The activation service is temporarily unavailable. Retry the same request.
scim.error.terminal: This activation cannot continue. Request a fresh notification.
